premises.text: Attention spans have decreased significantly among younger generations
premises.evidence_span: My generation has half the attention span that the generation before me did

premises.text: Students struggle to engage with traditional learning materials
premises.evidence_span: How do you convince a generation that spends eight hours a day on Snapchat and TikTok to spend two hours a day on a textbook

premises.text: Personalized and addictive learning solutions can improve student engagement
premises.evidence_span: what if we could make learning personalized? What if we could make learning addictive?

premises.text: Generative AI can help students learn faster and help teachers teach faster
premises.evidence_span: We're building generative AI to help students learn faster and help teachers teach faster

premises.text: OCR technology can quickly create study materials from textbooks
premises.evidence_span: All you have to do is point it at the text you want to scan, and we use OCR to grab the words out of the textbook

premises.text: AI can generate questions and answers based on important content
premises.evidence_span: our machine learning model creates questions and answers by knowing what's most important for you and what's not

premises.text: The speed of AI-generated content enhances user experience
premises.evidence_span: our Q&A generation algorithm takes 200 milliseconds to create questions and answers, whereas the next industry benchmark is 1,200 milliseconds

premises.text: The platform can be adapted for various educational and training contexts
premises.evidence_span: we now use our AI models beyond just students and we're able to service workplace and training

value.text: Students and employees can learn more efficiently and effectively through personalized AI-driven tools
value.evidence_span: building an information pipeline that not just we could use, but our peers could use
